ClosingCta.title: Ready to talk it through?
ClosingCta.description: Answer the five questions above and you'll hear back with a scope, a timeline, and a time to talk — not a hard sell.

lead-scraper-enrichment.name: Scraping & Enrichment
lead-scraper-enrichment.description: Pulling structured data out of unstructured web sources and enriching it with the context that makes it usable — company, role, recent activity — not just raw scraped rows.

invoice-ocr-pipeline.name: Document & Receipt OCR
invoice-ocr-pipeline.description: Turning photos and PDFs of receipts, invoices, and forms into clean, structured, exportable data — no manual retyping.

content-repurposing.name: Content Automation
content-repurposing.description: Breaking one piece of long-form content into platform-ready drafts automatically — transcript in, threads and captions out.

data-qa-audit.name: Data Auditing
data-qa-audit.description: Rule-based and LLM-based checks that catch bad records at scale, with a measurable accuracy score instead of a gut feeling.

api-workflow-integration.name: Backend Integrations
api-workflow-integration.description: Connecting the tools you already use so information moves between them automatically instead of being copy-pasted by hand.

custom-vision-model.name: Computer Vision
custom-vision-model.description: Training a model on your specific images when off-the-shelf OCR or object detection isn't accurate enough for the job.

Packages.listDescription: Each one has a defined scope and turnaround. No price is shown here — pick the one that matches what you need, submit a request, and you'll hear back with a price and a timeline.
Packages.noPriceNote: No price is shown here — submit a request and I'll reply with a price and timeline.

lead-scraper-enrichment.name: Custom Lead Scraper + Enrichment List
lead-scraper-enrichment.pitch: Scrape a defined source, enrich records, hand back a clean list.
lead-scraper-enrichment.whatItIs: You give me a defined source and the criteria that matter — I build a one-off scrape-and-enrich pass and hand back a clean, ready-to-use list instead of raw scraped rows.
whatsIncluded: Scrape of one clearly defined source against your criteria
Enrichment of each record with the context that makes it usable
A clean, deduplicated export (spreadsheet or CSV)

invoice-ocr-pipeline.name: Receipt/Invoice OCR Pipeline Setup
invoice-ocr-pipeline.whatItIs: A one-time setup that turns photos or PDFs of receipts and invoices into structured, exportable line items — no more retyping totals by hand.
whatsIncluded: Pipeline configured for your receipt/invoice format

content-repurposing.name: Content Repurposing Automation
content-repurposing.whatItIs: Feed in one raw video or transcript and get back a batch of platform-ready drafts — no more manually reformatting the same idea five different ways.
whatsIncluded: Transcription + key-idea breakdown of one source video/recording
Platform-ready drafts (threads, captions, a newsletter blurb)
One round of revisions on the draft set

data-qa-audit.name: Small-Scope Data QA/Audit Script
data-qa-audit.pitch: Rule + LLM-based checking of a defined dataset, with a measurable accuracy score.
data-qa-audit.whatItIs: A script that checks a defined dataset against rules and an LLM-based review pass, so you get a measurable accuracy score instead of a gut feeling about your data quality.
whatsIncluded: Rule-based + LLM-based checks against your dataset
A flagged-records report with a measurable accuracy score
The script itself, so you can re-run it later

api-workflow-integration.name: Custom API/Workflow Integration
api-workflow-integration.pitch: Connect 2+ tools/systems with a custom automation script.
api-workflow-integration.whatItIs: I connect two or more tools you already use with a custom automation script, so information moves between them on its own instead of being copy-pasted by hand.
whatsIncluded: Integration script connecting your specified tools/systems
Basic error handling and a run log
Handoff notes on how it works

custom-vision-model.name: Custom-Trained Vision Model (small scope)
custom-vision-model.pitch: A bespoke computer-vision model when off-the-shelf OCR/CV isn't accurate enough.
custom-vision-model.whatItIs: When general-purpose OCR or object detection isn't accurate enough for your specific images, I train a small-scope custom vision model against your actual data instead.
whatsIncluded: Model trained against a sample of your images
An accuracy report against a held-out test set
Delivery notes on how to run/integrate it
